evidence: Read-only discovery on 2026-09-28 (scripts/signup-selectors.ts, session arm — windowed Chrome) and a DOM read the same day of 'Join Qantas Frequent Flyer today': a join form (#joinForm… fields) that is present but hidden until its Get started link is used. Nothing was typed or submitted.
gotchas: The form is hidden when the page loads; the 'Get started' link on the page scrolls to and opens it.
The password fields are named Pin (#joinFormPin, #joinFormConfirmPin) and carry no length or pattern attribute; what they accept was not read. Check the hint beside the field before filling it.
The email is asked twice (#joinFormConfirmEmail), which no field in this recipe covers: type the same address there.
The form also requires country, title, gender, phone, street address, suburb, state, postcode and date of birth; they are the account owner's to supply.
